protocol.training: all original train windows plus one matched auxiliary batch per step; all 96 original training trajectories at half/eighth radiance
protocol.validation: 96 previously inspected synthetic trajectories and four disjoint relit validation trajectories
protocol.gate: each seed clean ADD-S success decline <=2pp; each seed improves depth at half and eighth physical radiance and never lowers relit pose success; both methods

original_confirmation.sample_contract: all original 16 candidate windows per trajectory, after the unchanged adapter visibility rule; not the four-window light-pilot subset

raw.action: real scoring blocked; keep all failed checks
raw.checkpoint_selection: fixed final synthetic weights; no real selection

original_confirmation_units.depth_mae: metres of absolute error reduction, baseline minus learned; not a relative ratio
original_confirmation_units.success: absolute success-rate fraction; multiply100 for percentage points
original_confirmation_units.exact_formula: delta = sign * (learned[metric] - baseline[metric]); sign=-1 for depth_mae, +1 for success; seed_improvement=delta.mean(rollouts)
original_confirmation_units.note: No division by baseline. CIs bootstrap96 original trajectories after averaging seeds and do not establish real-domain or new-data significance.

pose.interpretation: New paired short study completed all synthetic arms; low-light depth improves, but half-light and normal-light stability regress, so real evaluation correctly remains blocked.
